subtitle: English Topics 3
courseType:
English Language Program

educationalGoal: In English Topics 3, students will acquire English communication skills by studying various topics, English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. They will develop effective language learning techniques. They will also learn and practice presentation skills.
advice: The class will be conducted using the followings topics: Inspire 3 Unit 1 Friendship Unit 2 Fear Unit 3 Health Unit 4 Change Each class consists of active learning activities such as pair work, group work, and presentations. Students are expected to speak English enthusiastically and cooperate with others. It is necessary to check the e-syllabus (or Moodle) and student portal site before each class for homework materials, and to listen to the audio files that accompany the textbook. Students must bring their textbook to every class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary are necessary.

activityGoals.body: Listening: Listen and understand the overall content of each unit.
Vocabulary: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them in simpl
Reading: Understand the main points of the text.
Speaking: Conduct simple everyday classroom conversations.
Discuss the main points of each unit using the target expressions in simple sentences.
Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Listening: Listen and understand the content of the unit perfectly. ・Vocabulary: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them appropriately and correctly. ・Reading: Understand the main points of the text completely. ・Speaking: Conduct everyday classroom conversations. ・Discuss the main points of each unit using the target expressions orally and in writing. ・Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Listening: Listen and understand the overall content of the unit. ・Vocabulary: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and expressions in each unit and, though not perfectly, use them to form simple sentences. ・Reading: Understand the main points of the text. ・Speaking: Conduct simple everyday classroom conversations. ・Discuss the main points of each unit using the target expressions orally and in writing. ・Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying English regularly on their own.
